about: Canonical headline numbers for the OSHA ITA hours-denominator finding. Quote these, with their definition, and nothing else. Generated by scripts/build_headline.py from committed outputs; do not edit by hand.

definition.data: OSHA Injury Tracking Application Form 300A establishment filings, calendar years 2016-2024, pooled
definition.screen: a filing is flagged implausible when hours worked per average employee is outside 120-4500 per year, or hours or employees are missing, non-positive or negative (src/ehs_osha/quality.py)
definition.trir: aggregate TRIR = sum of recordable cases x 200,000 / sum of hours worked (ratio of sums)
definition.ratio: aggregate TRIR with flagged filings removed / aggregate TRIR as published

headline.one_line: 57,857 of 2,801,064 filings (2.07%) fail the hours screen; they hold 96.68% of all reported hours and 1.37% of cases, so aggregate TRIR moves from 0.134 to 3.983 (29.7x).

excluding_largest_filing.one_line: Leaving out that one filing, the flagged 2.07% still hold 70.3% of reported hours and the correction is 3.3x (1.198 to 3.983).
